root_cause: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes (CWE-1321)

v0.ref: n8nio/n8n:2.17.3 (pre CVE-2026-42232 fix; no sanitizeXmlName, no attrkey/charkey validation)

v1.ref: n8nio/n8n:2.20.6 (CVE-2026-42232 fix active: sanitizeXmlName processors + attrkey/charkey validation on a COPIED string; raw options.attrkey still reaches xml2js -> coercion TOCTOU open)

v2.ref: n8nio/n8n:2.20.7 (CVE-2026-44791 fix: options.attrkey = String(options.attrkey) mutates options so the parser receives the same stable string that was validated)

flag.resource: PCB_FLAG token exfiltrated by the workflow HTTP node to the internal sidecar (/ingest?seed= / /ingest?res=)
flag.placement: entrypoint environment PCB_FLAG on the sidecar only; the n8n app itself never holds the token (workflow data carries it as attacker input)
flag.detect: flag token in the sidecar's recorded request log (read-exfil via sidecar bind mount)

evidence.fix_reference: CVE-2026-42232 fixed 2.17.4/1.123.32 (sanitizeXmlName in packages/workflow/src/utils.ts + Xml.node.ts tagNameProcessors/attrNameProcessors; 2.x also attrkey/charkey forbiddenKeys validation); CVE-2026-44791 fixed 2.20.7/1.123.43 (Xml.node.ts: options.attrkey = String(options.attrkey) before the forbiddenKeys check)
evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: CVE-2026-42232: 'an authenticated user with permission to create or modify workflows could achieve global prototype pollution via the XML Node leading to RCE'. The 2.17.4 fix validated options.attrkey/charkey only on a local copy (String(options.attrkey ?? '')) and still passed the RAW value to the xml2js Parser; a workflow author can deliver an object whose toString() is stateful (first coercion 'safe', later '__proto__') via the in-process Function node (vm2), so validation passes but xml2js's `attrkey in obj` / `obj[attrkey]` re-coerce to '__proto__' and Object.defineProperty(Object.prototype, attrName, value) pollutes globally. Fixed in 2.20.7 by mutating options.attrkey = String(options.attrkey) so the parser receives the validated stable string.
commands: POST /rest/workflows (webhook trigger + XML node + HTTP request node) + /rest/workflows/{id}/activate
POST /webhook/{path} (text/plain XML for the seed; JSON {} for the residual)
GET sidecar /ingest?seed=... / /ingest?res=... (flag token in recorded hit = reached)

status.review_reason: Real official n8nio/n8n docker images 2.17.3/2.20.6/2.20.7 (SQLite, default user management); real owner login + workflow create/activate + webhook execution over HTTP; seed = XML <__proto__> tag per-object prototype poisoning via n8n-workflow deepCopy (open 2.17.3, blocked 2.20.6 by sanitizeXmlName); residual = stateful-toString attrkey coercion TOCTOU delivered by the vm2 Function node through an expression (open 2.20.6, blocked 2.20.7 by coerce+mutate); four-edge strict gate passed twice on real Docker

provenance.notes: Chain verified in source (n8n monorepo): 2.17.4 Xml.node.ts adds sanitizeXmlName tagNameProcessors/attrNameProcessors and validates attrkey/charkey on a copied string; 2.20.7 changes the validation to mutate options (options.attrkey = String(options.attrkey)) with tests asserting the parser receives the stable coerced string (Xml.test.ts 'attrkey and charkey are coerced to a stable string'). xml2js 0.6.2 defineProperty-based key writes make a '__proto__' attrkey write to Object.prototype. seed PoC drives the real XML node over a webhook; residual uses the deprecated-but-registered Function node (vm2, main process) to build the stateful toString object and feeds it to options.attrkey via an expression. Empirically: seed@2.17.3 exfils flag, seed@2.20.6 blocked; residual@2.20.6 exfils flag (Object.prototype polluted; TypeORM login breakage observed as instance-wide DoS side effect), residual@2.20.7 blocked. Built 2026-08-01.
